grilled_modifier.trigger: An allowlisted established modifier precedes grilled, which immediately precedes a food noun at the start of an attributive construction.
grilled_modifier.transformation: Join the modifier and grilled with a hyphen, preserving casing.

cast_iron.trigger: Cast iron immediately precedes an attributive food noun.
cast_iron.transformation: Join cast and iron with a hyphen, preserving casing.

brulee_participle.trigger: brûlée immediately precedes a recognized ingredient in an ingredient-preparation adjective construction.
brulee_participle.transformation: Change brûlée to brûléed, preserving casing.

expectations.casing: Preserve source casing for transformed words.
expectations.suffixes: Prices, allergen codes, separators, and unrelated text remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
expectations.idempotence: A second pass produces identical output.
expectations.approval_boundary: Motivating rows remain evidence; this artifact authorizes only the guarded generalized forms.
